Observed 2026-08-04 by the NATS wiring lane: com.rico.open-brain-local-clone failed at server/config.ts with 'EMBEDDING_API_KEY: Too small: expected string to have >=1 characters' at 14:34:52Z, while local-clone.env carries EMBEDDING_API_KEY= (empty — the local MLX embedder needs no key). The service subsequently relaunched and is currently healthy (pid 23572) with the same empty value, so the rejection is restart-path/intermittent — which makes it a tripwire, not a steady failure. Either the validator should treat empty-as-unset for a keyless local embedder (the #544 empty-string-env precedent), or the env line should be removed/populated — decide at the owning boundary. Same defect class as PR #544's empty-string finding.
